metadata.summary: Luke Humphries was not punished for a raft of missed finishing doubles as he beat a below-par Dave Chisnall to reach the second round of the World Grand Prix in Leicester.
metadata.content: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries and James Wade reach round two as Josh Rock and Chris Dobey dumped out | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries and James Wade reach round two as Josh Rock and Chris Dobey dumped out Luke Humphries - the new title favourite after Luke Littler's exit - beats below-par Dave Chisnall before appearing to shush member of crowd, will face Jermaine Wattimena next; other winners on Tuesday include Gian van Veen, Gary Anderson, Stephen Bunting and debutant Niels Zonneveld Wednesday 30 September 2026 00:02, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Luke Humphries taunted a fan who seemingly agitated the former world champion following his World Grand Prix win over Dave Chisnall Luke Humphries was not punished for a raft of missed finishing doubles as he beat a below-par Dave Chisnall to reach the second round of the World Grand Prix in Leicester. Humphries - who has made the last three finals in this event, winning in 2023 ahead of two runners-up finishes since - is the new favourite to triumph this year following defending champion Luke Littler's shock defeat to Luke Woodhouse on the opening night. Cool Hand, sporting a scab on his forehead he put down to an allergic reaction, defeated Chisnall 2-0 while averaging only 80.41 and going at 26 per cent on his doubles as he secured a second-round meeting with Chris Dobey's conqueror Jermaine Wattimena.
